title: XiaojinEditorial — Render Props
description: Props produced by P2 and passed to `npx remotion render XiaojinEditorial --props=<json>`. Mirrors XiaojinEditorialProps, adding durationSeconds (drives calculateMetadata) and dataCards (P3 must add an InfoCard-equivalent to the xiaojin component set). Units: scenes/chapters/introOutFrame in frames; captions in milliseconds. A plain-but-correct result must render from the required fields alone.

videoSrc.description: Path relative to remotion-composer/public/, e.g. jobs/<slug>/source.mp4

presenter.description: [presenter mode] speaker inset shown in the lower zone during b-roll windows; the card shows b-roll full-bleed. Written by the pipeline when insert_broll + apply_style co-occur.

durationSeconds.description: Full SOURCE asset duration; server-pinned, not user-editable. Always the untrimmed length — see videoCuts for the editor-authored cut list that derives the shorter OUTPUT duration (src/cuts.ts's computeOutputDuration).

videoCuts.description: Editor-authored razor cuts: REMOVED regions in SOURCE-video frames, half-open [fromFrame, toFrame). Absent/empty = untrimmed (strict no-op — every other frame/ms field in these props, and every existing job with no videoCuts, is unaffected). Every other time-bearing field in these props stays expressed in SOURCE coordinates forever, mapped to OUTPUT coordinates at render/preview time by src/cuts.ts — trimming the head is just a cut [0,N]; trimming the tail is [M, ceil(durationSeconds*30)]; a middle cut is any [A,B]. Server normalizes (sorts, merges overlapping/touching, clamps to the real source duration, drops empties) on save — see pipeline_runner._clamp_video_cuts.

videoVolume.description: Playback volume of the source speaker video, 0-1. Absent or 1 = unchanged — every job before this field existed rendered at full volume, and this is a no-op default. Live in the editor Player (a real <OffthreadVideo volume> prop). Does not affect the background music bed — see musicVolume, which is mixed post-render by ffmpeg and NOT audible in the editor preview.

musicVolume.description: Background music level for the editor save path, 0-0.4. Absent = leave the content-planning pipeline's own music choice untouched. 0 = drop the music bed entirely. Mixed post-render by ffmpeg (whatsapp_mvp/pipeline_runner.py's _op_add_music), so it is NOT audible in the editor's live preview — the editor UI must say so explicitly.

speakerObjectPosition.description: CSS object-position, e.g. "50% 35%"; calibrated on the SOURCE video's face, not the example video

scenes.description: Floating-card position schedule over time (frames). Minimum: one entry at frame 0.

introOutFrame.description: Frame at which the intro title card exits; chrome/captions hidden before it

chapters.description: Chapter markers. Produced by content_planner (single label); P3's ChapterNav uses label (+ optional labelEn).

captions.description: Per-phrase captions (milliseconds). Karaoke sweep is interpolated inside the component.

captionPosition.description: Optional override for where burned-in captions render, as a single-entry array so the editor's existing x/y/width drag overlay works unmodified (same shape every other positioned card uses). Absent (the default for every job the editor hasn't touched) means Captions.tsx keeps its original centered-bottom position -- adding this field changes nothing for jobs that never set it.

dataCards.description: [P3 NEW capability] count-up data cards. Mapped from content_planner's info_cards.

endFrame.description: Frame this card starts a 15-frame fade-out. Omit only if no later card ever occupies the same x/y — otherwise the two permanently overlap (confirmed bug: InfoCard had no exit logic at all).

mountOffset.description: Entrance offset (frames) relative to the card's mountFrame

labelEn.description: Optional secondary bilingual line under label (native big, EN small — reference-build style)

warn.description: Warning card — red accents (reference's lapse-warning styling)

layer.description: Stacking order within the content band -- higher draws on top of other content-zone cards. Absent = this section's default paint order (the order XiaojinEditorial.tsx has always rendered sections in), so every job before this field existed renders with byte-identical z-order. Clamped into the content band at render time -- a card can never be pushed behind the speaker card or above the intro/outro/caption chrome, regardless of this value.
